title: Amazon SQS messaging patterns
summary: Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) decouples producers from consumers with durable, managed queues. Learn Standard versus First-In-First-Out (FIFO) semantics, visibility timeout and Dead Letter Queues (DLQs), Lambda event source mappings, fan-out with Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) and EventBridge, and idempotent consumer design — the patterns senior interviews probe when debugging duplicate processing or poison messages.

topics.title: SQS Standard versus FIFO queues (ordering, throughput, and deduplication)
Visibility timeout, retries, and Dead Letter Queues (DLQ)
Lambda as an SQS consumer (batching, partial failure, and scaling)
SNS and EventBridge fan-out to SQS
